monkeytype — https://github.com/monkeytypegame/monkeytype
Pin: 91bd24bb8513785c7364cbea29296ff7adafac41 (master, 2026-08-15)
Licence: GNU GPL-3.0

Vendored into this GifOS port:

- frontend/static/languages/english.json        (200 most-frequent English words)
- frontend/static/languages/english_1k.json     (1000 most-frequent English words)
- frontend/static/quotes/english.json           (82 of 6488 quotes, ASCII, spread
                                                across short/medium/long/thicc)
- theme palettes transcribed from
  frontend/static/themes/*.css                  (colours only; no webfonts)

The huge React/TypeScript frontend is not shipped. This directory is a
classic-script recreation of the typing TEST (words, quotes, WPM/acc, caret,
themes, live race) so it can run inside a sandboxed App GIF with no network.

A copy of this app is a distribution of that GPL-3 work — COPYING.txt rides
inside the GIF.
